queries_run: AppLovin largest customer concentration risk advertisers in-house 2026
AppLovin single-source risk customer diversify supplier

findings.claim: AppLovin 10-Q 風險因素：廣告解決方案主要在行動 app 生態（特別是手遊），且大量營收經由數個第三方發行平台；管理層稱自 2024 起擴展至網頁電商廣告主（客群分散中）。搜尋未找到任何點名最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製的揭露。
findings.excerpt: We face concentration risk in that our advertising solutions primarily operate in the mobile app ecosystem and specifically mobile gaming. Further, a significant amount of our total revenue is derived through mobile applications subject to a limited number of third-party distribution platforms

customer_second_source.note: 無任何單一客戶占比或 in-house 轉移的來源；二手報導稱無客戶超過 10% 營收（未核原文）。
